summary: Tested 2 specific bug fixes: (1) CRM code removal from product detail page, (2) subcategory navigation in catalog sidebar. All 5 test scenarios from review request passed.
critical_code_review_comments: NOTE: product-detail.html has no CRM code - only articleCode (ART:) shown at lines 109-113 and the bottom meta grid only shows Product ID, Model, Unit. Fix confirmed.

NOTE: catalog.ts loadCategoryBySlug sets categories.signal to category.children only when children.length > 0. If a leaf category (no children) is clicked from sidebar, the sidebar keeps showing the parent's subcategories (previous level). This is acceptable UX behavior - next level drill-down continues to show sub-subcategories.

NOTE: onBreadcrumbClick uses full cat.slug (not last segment). For parent categories (e.g. 'telecommunication') this works fine. For child categories in breadcrumb, the slug 'telecommunication/odn-...' would navigate to a multi-segment URL that won't match the /catalog/:categorySlug route. However, the breadcrumb click on 'Telecommunication' works correctly since it's a root category slug.

NOTE: Direct SSR URL for product with percent-encoded slashes (e.g. /product/telecom%2Fodn%2F...) redirects to home. Product detail only works via Angular SPA router.navigate() - same behavior as iteration_2 which was passing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Angular 21 SSR app. External API: https://planetworkspace.com/api. Product slugs contain full paths with slashes (e.g. 'telecommunication/cable-mounting/.../product-name'). Product detail only works via SPA navigation (router.navigate), not direct SSR URL. Category fix: subcategories appear in sidebar when parent category clicked. Both fixes verified working.
